name: Busnago (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Busnago (a red lion rampant on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Busnago, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Busnago arms — red lion rampant on white, crowned, within branches
